title: AATIP, OAP and the UAP Task Force as red teams for the legacy program

tellings.quote: I think people well this gets into the fun with ATIP OAP UAP task force and the theory that a lot of that was red teaming the legacy program

plain: From 2007 to 2021, the government's public UFO efforts may have been "red teaming", meaning acting as outside testers, for a far older secret effort that is said to hold recovered craft not made by humans, known as the legacy program. Those public efforts were AATIP, a small Pentagon office that studied unexplained aerial reports, a later office called OAP, and the UAP Task Force, a Pentagon group set up to study UAP, the government's term for UFOs. A man named Dylan Borland offers this to Michels as a theory, "I think", and points to the DIRDs, research papers written for AATIP, as part of the trail.
